# Real trajectory excerpts

Each fixture comes from the first five action steps for one of the two task IDs shown in the Phase 1 inspection. See the pilot configuration for the exact upstream object key. The excerpts preserve native structure and the fields needed to check action and outcome mapping. Long prompts, observations and edit payloads are clipped, and unused fields are omitted.

The legacy SWE-agent and Devstral OpenHands excerpts come from the expanded cohort's xarray task. They exercise the `swe_main` environment label and the text-serialized OpenHands tool protocol.
